title: Trove note
description: One line of notes/<source>/YYYY-MM.jsonl: a single collected note, keyed by id. A per-source snapshot of the present, rewritten whole per affected month (of created) on each sync/import. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

id.description: source-native note id, the dedupe key (Bear ZUNIQUEIDENTIFIER, Day One / Notion / Roam uuid, Keep filename, vault-relative path)

title.description: note title (explicit, or the filename / first line / H1 where the source has no title field); omit when the source has none

body.description: the full note text, verbatim — Markdown / plain text / HTML→Markdown (full fidelity; trimming or rendering is a read-time opinion)
examples:
# Garden planting plan

- Tomatoes in the south bed
- #garden #spring

created.description: RFC3339 local time the note was created (falls back to file mtime where that is all the source exposes)

modified.description: RFC3339 local time the note was last edited

tags.description: note tags, verbatim (Bear/Drafts tags, Day One/Keep labels, frontmatter tags)

folder.description: the note's one place: folder / notebook / collection / group name, or vault-relative path for folder-tree sources

archived.description: archived (out of the active set, not deleted)

trashed.description: in trash / soft-deleted (kept for fidelity; a read-time filter decides whether to surface)

extra.description: everything source-specific (full fidelity): Day One location/weather/mood, Stoic mood/metrics, Keep checklist items + color, Roam/Reflect backlinks, frontmatter, content-type/format marker, …
